description: Magnificent classical parisien apt recently renovated with 4 spacious and separate bedrooms, 2 en suite with new king size beds 180cms and 2 with new queen size beds 160cms,2 bathrooms with bathtubs and large italian showers, 1 toilet shower room, 1 toilet, spacious living room with crown molding , a fully equipped kitchen dining room, laundry room, very fast internet, 160 square meters.The spaceLocated in the charming « bo-bo » ( Bourgeois-Bohème) neighbourhood of Canal St Martin, situated in central Paris, this four-bedroom apartment will offer you a real Parisian expérience.This 3rd floor hausmanian apartment 160m2 with elevator has all the original features, High ceilings oak parquets floors, beautiful mouldings and antique marble chimneys.The entrance hall leads to a spacious and bright living room with two large sofas, the modern kitchen is fully equipped ( dish washer, coffee machine, kettle, gaz cooker, fridge, kitchen utensils) with a large dining table that seats 10 people. There are two double bedrooms with king size beds, each with an individual luxurious bathroom with bath and shower and toilet. The two other bedrooms with queen size beds share a smaller shower room with toilet and sink.There is an extra separate guests toilet There is a laundry room, TV, Wifi and fans. This apartment with it’s fine decoration and spacious rooms will offer you a real taste of Parisian luxury !The area is well known for its upcoming fashion boutiques, traditional local grocery stores including one of Paris’s best Boulangeries (bakery ) and many delicious restaurants and bars.The Marais area is within walking distance, and the subway will get you easily around Paris.
